final_receipt.source_bindings: canonical caseconfig tree records and exact3module/hash expected fields

monitored_timing: 20s abort is a supplemental controller Event. 180s overall fixture budget is a checked elapsed budget at stage boundaries, not hard preemption of every setup/read or Python startup. Each component subprocess keeps its own bounded timeout. If consumed, no controller start or further admission. No alternative supervisor is introduced.
failure: No output path deletion or retry. If case root preexists, NOT_STARTED ALREADY_ATTEMPTED and no write. If source/input invalid beforecasecreation, no record. If admitted failure, retainstage/attemptcount withpayload-free reasons; no fabricated completed bindings. Writefinalrecordonlyif ownership intact. Close only ownfixturehandle; failure setsCLEANUP_UNCONFIRMED and cannotPASS.
authority: No CLI or run permission. Currentrootcaseimplementation waits for frozen fixture+acceptance dependencies; mocks only. Independentwholecase review and explicitroot one-case clearance still needed.
